position_sizing.conditional_logic: Starts at base lot; on loss, next trade lot is doubled (martingale). On win, reset to base lot. Lot = previous_lot * multiplier after each consecutive loss.

custom_logic_notes: Martingale lot sizing: after a losing trade (closed by SL), the next entry lot size is doubled. After a winning trade (closed by TP), the lot size resets to the initial base lot. This creates exponential risk on consecutive losses. The EA tracks the last trade result to determine current lot sizing. Classic Martin strategy - extremely risky as consecutive losses cause geometric lot growth.
